about.title: A dental clinic built for the whole family
body: iDentist Family Dental Care was started with one goal — to be the clinic a family in Madhanandapuram can trust for every dental need, at every age, without having to travel across the city for a specialist.

Whether it's a toddler's first dental visit, a teenager needing braces, or a grandparent needing a root canal or dentures, our team treats each patient with the same unhurried, careful attention — in a clinic that feels approachable rather than clinical.
highlights: Treatment for every age, from toddlers to seniors
Same-day appointments for most routine procedures
Modern, sterile equipment and painless technique
Conveniently located on Mugalivakkam Main Road

services.name: Dental Checkups & Cleaning
services.tagline: Routine care that catches problems early
services.overview: Regular checkups and professional cleaning form the foundation of family dental health — we recommend a visit every six months for every family member above age three.
procedure: Oral examination and X-ray if needed
benefits: Catches cavities and gum disease early
Removes tartar buildup that brushing can't
Quick, painless, and suitable for all ages
services.recovery: No downtime — you can eat and drink normally right after.

faqs.question: How often should I get a dental checkup?
faqs.answer: We recommend a checkup and cleaning every six months for adults and children alike.

faqs.question: Is scaling bad for teeth?
faqs.answer: No — scaling only removes tartar and plaque from the tooth surface, it doesn't damage enamel.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.tagline: Save the natural tooth, relieve the pain
services.overview: Dr. Priya specializes in painless, single-to-multi-sitting root canal treatment to relieve infection and save your natural tooth wherever possible.
symptoms: Sensitivity to hot or cold that lingers
Swelling or tenderness in the gums
procedure: Removal of infected pulp and canal cleaning
Crown placement to protect the tooth
benefits: Saves your natural tooth instead of extraction
Modern technique keeps the process largely painless
services.recovery: Mild sensitivity for a few days is normal; most patients resume normal eating within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Is root canal treatment painful?
faqs.answer: With local anesthesia, the procedure itself is largely painless — most discomfort patients fear is from the untreated infection, not the treatment.

faqs.question: How many visits does it take?
faqs.answer: Most root canals are completed in one to two sittings, depending on the tooth and severity of infection.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.tagline: A brighter smile in one sitting
services.overview: Safe, professional in-office whitening that lifts stains from tea, coffee, and everyday wear without damaging enamel.
procedure: Whitening gel application under controlled conditions
benefits: Visible results in a single sitting
Safer and more even than over-the-counter kits
services.recovery: Mild sensitivity for a day or two; avoid staining foods and drinks for 48 hours.

faqs.question: How long does whitening last?
faqs.answer: Results typically last 12–18 months depending on diet and oral hygiene habits.

services.name: Braces & Clear Aligners
services.tagline: Straighter teeth for teens and adults
services.overview: Dr. Arvind offers both traditional braces and clear aligners, matched to your bite, budget, and lifestyle — for teenagers and adults alike.
benefits: Options for both visible and near-invisible correction
Custom treatment plans for teens and adults
Regular monitoring to keep treatment on track
services.recovery: Mild soreness for 2-3 days after adjustments is normal and manageable with over-the-counter pain relief.

faqs.question: At what age can my child start orthodontic treatment?
faqs.answer: We typically evaluate children from age 7, though most active treatment starts between ages 10-14.

faqs.question: How long does treatment take?
faqs.answer: Most cases take 12–24 months depending on the complexity of the correction needed.

services.name: Pediatric Dentistry
services.tagline: Gentle dental care for your child's first visits
services.overview: A calm, friendly approach to children's dentistry — from first checkups to cavity fillings — designed to build good dental habits early and avoid dental fear later in life.
procedure: Friendly introductory visit and oral exam
Fluoride application or sealants as needed
Guidance for parents on home care
benefits: Builds comfort with dental visits from an early age
Preventive focus reduces future treatment needs
services.recovery: No downtime for routine visits; simple aftercare guidance given for any treatment performed.

faqs.question: When should my child's first dental visit be?
faqs.answer: We recommend a first visit by age one, or within six months of the first tooth appearing.

blogPosts.title: When Should Your Child First Visit the Dentist?
blogPosts.excerpt: Many parents wait until something looks wrong — here's why an earlier first visit actually prevents problems.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Arvind Shankar
content: Most parents assume dental visits should start once all baby teeth have come in, but the general recommendation is much earlier — by your child's first birthday, or within six months of the first tooth appearing.
Early visits aren't about treatment; they're about getting your child comfortable with the clinic environment, and catching early signs of decay or misalignment before they become bigger problems.
A first visit is usually short and simple — a gentle look at the teeth and gums, and guidance for parents on brushing technique, diet, and thumb-sucking habits if relevant.
Starting early also builds a habit. Children who visit the dentist regularly from a young age tend to have far less dental anxiety as adults.
